offers.brand: Reno Veterans Day Parade and opening ceremony
offers.offer: The City of Reno's Veterans Day Parade: the opening ceremony at 11:11 AM near the Virginia Street Bridge (prayer, national anthem, city proclamation), then the parade north on Virginia Street from Liberty Street to Sixth Street. Free and open to all.
offers.limits: Streets close 5 AM-3 PM: Virginia St from Liberty St to Sixth St, and First St from N Sierra St to University Way. End time not published.
offers.notes: The City of Reno's own release (3 Nov 2026): the opening ceremony at 11:11 AM near the Virginia Street Bridge, just south of First St (prayer, national anthem, city proclamation), then the parade north on Virginia St from Liberty St to Sixth St; spectators gather along the route. Grand marshal: retired Maj. Gen. Ron Bath. Streets close 5 AM-3 PM: Virginia St from Liberty to Sixth, and First St from N Sierra St to University Way. RTC buses are free all day. End time not published; streamed on the city's YouTube from 11 AM.

other.name: National parks: fee-free day for US residents
